comparison.objective: Secure a housing in a rollover fixture, invert and lock it, then install a wear pad; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Fixture loading, bar/bolt operation, controlled inversion and pad insertion versus fine blade-under-tab insertion and coordinated pull.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly retained/inverted/locked fixture and seated pad with hands away; candidate requires selective terminal extraction without bypass or damage. Candidate lacks exact thresholds.
comparison.reason: Different multi-stage assembly objective and physical constraints.
